purpose: Replace anonymous repeated /wc launches against mutable global frontier with one Guide-compiled immutable run packet whose workers atomically self-assign unique launch slots, load long exact context only after slot ownership, and remain resident after completing the slot's first project.

human_contract.note: The Guide emits one prompt containing one run_id. Slot numbers are machine-assigned atomically; the human never types or tracks S01/S02/etc.
human_contract.replenishment_rule: After the initial identical launches, Guide computes durable run occupancy from beacons + primary claims. Any fresh RUN beacon with no primary claim is a lost capacity attempt, not a filled slot. While packet status remains ARMED and compatible primary slots remain unclaimed, Guide may request exactly the number of replacement launches needed to refill those slots, using the same human prompt and no human numbering/routing. Replacement launches are additional launch attempts, not extra experiment replicas.
human_contract.human_action_boundary: External chat creation remains a human wake boundary. Guide must minimize it to one identical prompt repeated only for the exact refill count derived from durable status.

packet_projection.rationale: Pages is the compiled read surface. Put enough exact context, acceptance criteria, candidate bundles, source refs, non-goals and test commands there to minimize worker archaeology.

slot_model.selection_seed: fresh beacon commit SHA when available; otherwise launch_nonce
slot_model.selection_rule: Filter packet slots by capabilities definitively available in the runtime; hash into the compatible slot list; on CREATE_EXISTS advance cyclically through untried compatible slots. No mutable frontier reread is required to obtain a slot.

slot_capsule.authority_boundary: The packet/capsule supplies context and routing intent; durable PIN/claim remains execution authority unless the slot itself is an explicitly authorized synthetic benchmark fixture.

capability_aware_occupancy.rule: Guide computes launch slots from compatible demand, not total candidate count. Generic chat runtimes do not consume slots whose required capabilities are definitively unavailable.
capability_aware_occupancy.oversubscription_allowed_when: Measured slot completion/replenishment evidence justifies it; never infer from raw frontier_total alone.

observability.benefit: A human statement such as 'I launched 17 chats' becomes directly comparable to a durable run packet instead of being inferred from timestamps.

denominators.rule: Never substitute launch_attempt count for slot occupancy or terminal completion.

residency.after_primary_complete: Return evidence, refresh exact allowed allocation surface, claim a second compatible project/lane, and continue until residency target or real boundary.
residency.existing_pool_law: 3 checkpoint / target 6 / cap 8 remains binding unless benchmark-specific stricter completion is declared.

terminal_reply_latch.run_rule: In RUN mode, a human-facing terminal response is forbidden immediately after primary completion/E7. Before any final response, the worker must either (A) complete E8 reallocation and E9 exam/close with durable receipt evidence, or (B) persist an explicit terminal boundary/no-allocation record naming the earliest non-PASS stage and exact failure code.
terminal_reply_latch.abrupt_runtime_end_boundary: A runtime/chat that ends without satisfying the latch can still happen; Guide/runtime observability must classify it as incomplete and replenish/recover rather than treating UI cessation as success.

implementation_order: DONE: canonical packet compiler + public /launch/<run_id>/ projection
DONE: exact long slot capsules and public status.json
DONE: RUN mode in /wc with fresh beacon then atomic slot claim
DONE: run/slot fields in runtime and scoreboard
DONE: static packet accounting validator and runtime regression
DONE: static Cat Lab/Dog Notes contracts plus representative Chromium workflow
DONE: CATLAB-EVO-01 ARMED with 10 exact slots; next external action is exactly 10 identical RUN launches
DONE: RUN refill accounting distinguishes launch attempts from slot occupancy after observed 10-beacon/9-claim CATLAB loss
DONE: RUN terminal-reply latch forbids silent stop after primary receipt and requires E8/E9 or durable boundary evidence
non_goals: replacing execution authority with a static webpage
creating filler slots to hit a desired worker count
making packet creation an endless experiment

entry_chain.invariant: Human prompt -> parse RUN -> fresh beacon -> exact packet -> atomic slot -> slot capsule -> bounded plan -> produce -> verify -> receipt -> reallocate -> exam/close.

slot_claim_schema.collision: CREATE_EXISTS means owned by another worker; cycle to next retained compatible slot
slot_claim_schema.owner_uniqueness: One claim path = one slot owner. A worker claiming >1 primary slot is a protocol failure.

selection_engineering.reason: Second/minute-based assignment can synchronize many launches onto the same shard and is not stable enough for reconstruction.
selection_engineering.algorithm: stable compatible slot list; seed modulo length; cyclic linear probe on CREATE_EXISTS; each compatible slot at most once
selection_engineering.benefit: No human numbering, exact reproducibility, bounded collisions, and all slots remain reachable even under identical starting seeds.

stage_evolution.rule: Test stage-level laws rather than ten unrelated full prompts. Current exploration uses 5 variants x 2 replicas on identical Cat Lab objectives; only one stage rule changes per variant.
stage_evolution.promotion: Exploration n=2 selects at most two candidates; any law requires >=3 independent confirmation workers before promotion.

replenishment.trigger: packet ARMED AND slots_unclaimed > 0 AND durable RUN beacons without primary claim > 0 after the initial launch burst has visibly settled
replenishment.refill_count: min(slots_unclaimed, workers_beaconed_without_primary_claim) for the immediate repair cycle; recompute after every refill, never prelaunch a speculative surplus
replenishment.experiment_semantics: A replacement that claims an existing unclaimed slot becomes that slot's intended replica. The failed preclaim launch remains run-level E0-E2 platform evidence and is never attributed to the replacement slot's variant.
replenishment.stop: No refill when slots_unclaimed=0, packet is not ARMED, or a real authority/safety boundary blocks further launch attempts.
